Stop active execution through client cancellation and native stop verification.

post.description: Supports ollama automatic capabilities and the native typesafe/Jev protocol. Omit models for discovery; explicit model/models subsets also detect Ollama capabilities. Precedence: discovery, top-level capabilities/endpoints, individual models, then model_capabilities/model_endpoints maps. Public services are visible to all callers; private services only to the registrant. Register a base_url/models API or explicitly supply model/models. Explicit specialized models should declare endpoints; ordinary chat defaults are inferred from the protocol; capabilities/model_kind supports capability filtering. model_endpoints/model_capabilities can override individual models. ttl_seconds defaults to 90. Stale entries are removed automatically. A full registration snapshot heartbeat restores the same service after a restart or disconnect. Registration accepts access_key (true/string/null) for all submitted models and model_access_keys keyed by native model ID for per-model overrides. These require the owner’s VOS token; provider api_key remains separate. Omission preserves existing model keys. Change existing model keys using PUT /api/v1/models/access-key.
